name: WhatsApp Doctor Appointment Booking
description: Deterministic WhatsApp booking flow for a dental clinic: 7-8:30 PM evening slots, availability checked before collecting patient details, next-day offer when today is full, reset-conversation escape hatch on repeated invalid input, professional tone throughout.

main.node: Route Next Day Yes or No
Upsert Session - Next Day Slot Confirm

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", recipient_type: "individual", to: $json.waId, type: "interactive", interactive: { type: "button", body: { text: "Welcome to *our Clinic*\n\nAre you looking to book an appointment for *today*?" }, action: { buttons: [ { type: "reply", reply: { id: "yes", title: "Yes" } }, { type: "reply", reply: { id: "no", title: "No" } } ] } } } }}
